rationale: The agent found that GC content (0.41 vs 0.55) separates the classes, and it measured that a GC threshold alone reaches 1.00 test accuracy, compared with the model's 0.99. It proposed GC-matched negatives and composition controls. It also correctly pointed out that the 'novel phage' claim was never tested: the test set has no divergent phages and no homology-based tool was compared.
